one_liner: Nifty 50 rises 0.58% amid mixed market performance.

drivers.title: FII Inflows
drivers.detail: FIIs were net buyers with Rs 4,864.68 Cr inflow.

drivers.title: Negative Breadth
drivers.detail: Market breadth was negative with 1,937 declines.

flows_line: FIIs net bought Rs 4,864.68 Cr; DIIs net sold Rs 3,519.05 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for Nifty 50 weekly expiry and US retail sales data tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Nifty 50 can rise despite negative breadth.
FIIs continue to influence market direction.
Volatility can increase even with index gains.
Sectoral performance can diverge from index trends.
